generator.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one coherent environment background plate with two focal crop uses for a survival strategy game, not a split-screen. Rough aged brown plywood panels, grey corrugated metal upper walls, exposed steel joists, dusty concrete floor, worn economical industrial furnishings. LEFT ZONE x=12%-43%: old wooden registration desk with completely bare top, a plain narrow closed metal filing cabinet with drawers and no labels, one simple empty chair tucked under the desk. No paper, binder, receipt, map, keys or object on desk. RIGHT ZONE x=60%-84%: a plain old chair and a narrow simple worker resting cot against the wall with a thin drab brown-grey mattress, no hospital rail, no medical mechanisms, no equipment. A modest dark window can sit above it, showing no specific location. The center must remain simple bare wall and clear low-contrast floor so the frame can support an independently rendered action overlay. Cinematic photorealistic game environment illustration, dense tactile surface details in scratched plywood, oxidized metal, dusty joints, aged fabric and scuffed concrete; natural plausible scale. Restrained cool blue-grey ambient light with one dim amber industrial wall lamp, warm grey-brown atmosphere, abandoned and quiet but readable. Stable eye-level 28 mm wide near-frontal composition, no dutch angle or heavy blur. Left desk/cabinet and right resting nook each entirely visible with room around silhouettes, support left-biased L1 and right-biased L5 crops, full composition remains coherent. No people, NPC, enemy, human silhouette, reflection, body, blood or gore. No HUD, UI, interface frame, icons, labels, words, letters, numbers, signs, receipts, charts, clocks, logo or watermark. No visible supplies, loot, bag, food, drink, tool, medical equipment, trade merchandise, reward or free pickup. No shop counter display, cash register or vending machine. All file cabinet drawers closed. Furniture is environment only: do not imply automatic rest recovery, free materials, an extra shop or new gameplay command. Visual reuse must not imply that L1 registration room and L5 worker rest room are merged into one canonical node or adjacent. Deliver one clean full-bleed native 3840x2160 PNG.
